description: Isolates the two branches of BidiUtils.localeUsesRightToLeftScript on one primary language. 'ar' has no script subtag, so the method takes the CldrLocaleData.likelySubtagFor branch (ar -> ar-Arab-EG, script Arab, which is in GeneratedCldrLocaleData.RTL_SCRIPTS); 'ar-Latn' carries an explicit script that short-circuits that lookup and is LTR. Both are loaded catalogs so each request resolves to itself and the requested/donor question does not confound the script question. Two locales share the language code ar, so tiebreakers are mandatory and list exactly {ar, ar-Latn} -- an exact permutation, as DefaultStrings.java:393-408 requires.
